mapper.sql:
SELECT id, perm_code AS permCode, perm_name AS permName, perm_type AS permType, parent_id AS parentId, path, method, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM rbac_permission WHERE (#{permType} IS NULL OR #{permType} = '' OR perm_type = #{permType})
AND (perm_name LIKE #{keyword} OR perm_code LIKE #{keyword})
ORDER BY COALESCE(parent_id, 0), id
